item.title: Rust Development Updates — Oct 16
item.description:
63 development commits

Combat & Grenades

  • Fixed grenades attached to players not appearing until the reveal animation, ensuring they are visible immediately.

Server & Settings

  • Fixed a bug where joining a server would reset custom game mode settings (convars) to defaults, preserving clan and server configurations.

Gameplay & Balance

  • Scarecrows no longer trigger errors, restoring their defensive functionality.
  • Head IK now correctly follows up/down movements, and player pooling during turn transitions is stable, reducing combat glitches.
  • Live tattoo painting now respects separate visibility for new ink, preventing unintended fading of fresh designs.

Development

  • WIP: Unify FSM states, sharing dead, repellant flee, and debug move states.
